svg.title: plumbbob: the plan is a file you keep true
svg.desc: intent.md holds the frame, the decisions with their because, the steps with what done looks like, and where the build stops. The loop runs from it: the model builds a step, the pause shows the check and a readout, you type looks good, and a checkpoint commits the step with its why. Only a prompt you typed lands a step; that is the latch. A surprise mid-step is parked as one line, harvested cold at the boundary, and folded back into intent.md as a Decision and a new step. At finish the build folder rides the pull request beside the code. On the line, plumbbob is the middle hop: a checked plan becomes code, a step at a time.
